neet_phy_u09_t06_1.working: Since λ ∝ 1/d² at fixed n, doubling d makes λ' = λ/4.

neet_phy_u09_t06_2.working: λ = kT/(√2πd²P), so λ ∝ T at constant P. T goes from 300 K to 600 K, so λ' = 2λ.

neet_phy_u09_t06_4.working: In a rigid closed container n is constant, so λ = 1/(√2πd²n) does not change on heating. A is false and R is true.

neet_phy_u09_t06_5.working: λ ∝ T/P, so at constant P λ ∝ T, not 1/T: I is incorrect. For II, λ' = λ×(2)/(1/2) = 4λ: II is correct.
